normalized_matching_profile.description: Home Highlights: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 10 wristbands.- Located in WaterColor's Park District- 5-minute stroll to the beach - Close to WaterColor Town Center- Large, first-floor primary suite- Sitting/media area on second floor- Large front porch- 3 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: 139 Mystic Cobalt is a 3-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home located in the heart of WaterColor's Park District. Less than a 5-minute stroll to the beach and close proximity to the WaterColor town center, guests will love being in the heart of it all. What makes this home so special is the open living and dining area making large family gatherings easy! The spacious primary suite is located on the first floor, along with 2 guest bedrooms on the second floor and a small sitting/media area located at the top of the landing providing private space for the upstairs guest. Take your stay outside and enjoy the large front porch space giving the first floor an added feeling of space and livability.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSFIRST FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bath with Shower and TubSECOND FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bath with Shower OnlyGuest Bedroom: 2 Queen Beds with Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bath with Shower/Tub ComboWATERCOLOR NEIGHBORHOOD HIGHLIGHTS:- Named the #1 family vacation destination in the U.S.- A 499-acre coastal resort and residential community- Ideal bike community perfect for family getaways- Pristine sugar sand beaches- 4 swimming pools- Award-winning tennis facilities- Championship golf nearby- World Famous Beach Club- Unparalleled beachside, poolside, and lakeside dining- Acres of parks, gardens, and footpaths- Nearby state parks and preservesPlease note: Effective March 15, 2014, Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 60 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home, and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.

This home is allotted 10 wristbands. - Located in WaterColor's Park District - 5-minute stroll to the beach - Close to WaterColor Town Center - Large, first-floor primary suite - Sitting/media area on second floor - Large front porch - 3 adult bikes - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico. DETAILS: 139 Mystic Cobalt is a 3-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home located in the heart of WaterColor's Park District. Less than a 5-minute stroll to the beach and close proximity to the WaterColor town center, guests will love being in the heart of it all. What makes this home so special is the open living and dining area making large family gatherings easy! The spacious primary suite is located on the first floor, along with 2 guest bedrooms on the second floor and a small sitting/media area located at the top of the landing providing private space for the upstairs guest. Take your stay outside and enjoy the large front porch space giving the first floor an added feeling of space and livability. Only one cart may be rented per home, and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.
